(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 5)))
             (define r0 (first bb))
             (define c0 (second bb))
             (define r1 (third bb))
             (define c1 (fourth bb))
             (define pw (+ 1 (- c1 c0)))
             (define move-right? (< c0 (quotient w 2)))
             (define br
               (min-of first
                       (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 6))
                               (grid-positions g))))
             (define final-start
               (if move-right? (- (- w pw) (max 0 (- r1 r0 1))) (max 0 (- r1 r0 1))))
             (define (start-for-row r)
               (let ((shift (max 0 (- r r0 1))))
                 (if move-right? (- (- w pw) shift) shift)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (cond
                        ((and
                           (>= r r0)
                           (<= r r1)
                           (>= c (start-for-row r))
                           (< c (+ (start-for-row r) pw))) (at g r (+ c0 (- c (start-for-row r)))))
                        ((and
                           (= r br)
                           (if move-right?
                               (< c (+ final-start (- pw 1)))
                               (> c final-start))) 9)
                        ((< r br) 1)
                        (else 6)))))))
